articles.title: From writing code to growing mushrooms: How this BTech graduate left IT after 14 years to build a farming business earning over Rs 10 lakh a month
articles.summary: After 14 years in the IT industry, BTech graduate Vikramdev Mohapatra left his corporate career to return to Nabarangpur, Odisha, and build a commercial mushroom farming business. His venture, Ganga Bhumi Mushrooms, produces 500–600 kg of mushrooms daily and supplies markets in Brahmapur and Bhubaneswar.

articles.title: The history student who changed physics forever: The PhD thesis Albert Einstein said had ‘lifted a corner of the great veil’
articles.summary: Louis de Broglie began as a history student before turning toward mathematics and physics, ultimately reshaping modern science. In his 1924 PhD thesis, he proposed that particles such as electrons possess wave-like properties, challenging established ideas about matter.

articles.title: CSIR-NET answer key 2026 out: Check response sheet, Rs 200 challenge fee and deadline
articles.summary: CSIR NET answer key 2026: NTA has released the Joint CSIR-UGC NET June 2026 provisional answer key and recorded responses on August 16. Candidates can challenge the key until August 18 at 11:00 PM by paying Rs 200 per question.
